scenario: 今天的生成式赛道在问同一件事：生成式推荐怎样在上线约束里仍然可算、可信、可用。有人先把长输入、宽 beam 的推理流水线做对，而不急着写自定义算子；多模态 Semantic ID 扩散则要判断一种模态能不能缩小当前目录里的候选。离线日志上的流网络目标不能从在线设定原样搬来，偏好优化也会在未采样物品上被钻空子；长历史得先压成兴趣速写，自动演化推荐模型则需要指出问题在哪、该往哪改的反馈。用药组合把安全约束放到推理过程里，医疗概念则把层级写进标识本身。生成能不能用，越来越取决于约束有没有被写进生成过程。

papers.title: Optimize the Cob, Then the Kernel: Optimizing Beam Search for Generative Recommendation Inference
papers.authors: Shing Wai Pun, Kai Wu, Pengfei Xia, Hui Zang, Wei Guo, Yong Liu
papers.summary: 生成式推荐的推理和普通大模型服务很不一样：输入很长，beam 很宽，输出却只有固定的几个 token。现有引擎常把每条 beam 当成互不相关的序列来批处理，共享前缀的 KV 会被重复读取；每一步生成还要单独调用一次引擎，主机制梁处理和运行时的缓存块管理都堆在步骤之间。这里用 Tree Attention 把各条 beam 沿序列维拼在一起，去掉重复的 KV 访问，再配上预先生成的部分注意力掩码、静态 KV 分配、图编译、算子融合和词表约束解码。不用自定义算子，在昇腾 NPU 上相对 vLLM，端到端最多可加速约 25 倍，生成延迟也能接近使用自定义算子的现有方案。==先把整条生成流水线做对，再考虑要不要自写算子。==
papers.abstract: Generative recommendation (GR) inference differs substantially from conventional LLM serving, featuring long input sequences, wide beam search, and only a few fixed output tokens. Existing LLM serving engines such as vLLM process beams as batched independent sequences, causing redundant KV cache accesses over the shared prompt prefix. Furthermore, vLLM executes each beam search generation step as a separate engine invocation, incurring host-side beam processing overhead between decoding steps and substantial runtime KV block management in PagedAttention. Using Tree Attention, we concatenate beams along the sequence dimension to eliminate redundant KV accesses, and further optimize execution through pre-generated partial-attention masks, static KV cache allocation, loop-unrolled generation dispatch, TorchAir graph compilation, automatic operator fusion, and vocabulary-constrained decoding. Without the use of custom kernels, our approach reduces end-to-end latency by up to 25x over vLLM
papers.score_note: 针对生成式推荐推理（长输入、宽 beam、短固定输出）优化 Tree Attention 与静态 KV，相对 vLLM 端到端延迟最高约 25x，且无需自定义 kernel。生成式赛道核心，不放到 infra 以免跨赛道重复。

papers.title: CONCORD-Rec: Catalog-Conditioned Modality Utility for Semantic-ID Diffusion Recommendation
papers.authors: Haopeng Jin, Bingkang Shi, Tao Yu, Yifei Ma, Hao Liu, Hongzhu Yi, Jinwen Luo
papers.summary: 用离散 Semantic ID 做多模态生成式推荐时，历史里的影像或文本并不总是在减少目录中的歧义，有的只是改了 token 的预测；模态一旦缺失、劣化或相互冲突，均匀融合还可能把误导信息带进逐步去噪。一套方法用反事实的目录划分效用来监督模态门控：在相同的可行目录和部分遮蔽的 Semantic ID 上，比较有无某一模态时目标分组的损失，再按位置、按可用性分配有界的模态修正，并保留纯行为预测作为回退。在 MicroLens-100K 上，干净条件下 NDCG@20 相对均匀融合提高 4.00%，在 30% 的模态缺失时相对提高 7.95%，说明内容不完整时，按位置分配模态仍然有用。==模态有没有用，要看它能不能缩小当前目录里的候选范围。==
papers.abstract: Multimodal generative recommendation with discrete semantic identifiers (SIDs) requires distinguishing historical modalities that merely alter token predictions from those that genuinely reduce catalog-level ambiguity. When audiovisual, visual, or textual streams are missing, degraded, or semantically conflicting, uniform fusion and unconstrained token gates can propagate misleading content across iterative denoising steps. We propose CONCORD-Rec, a reliability-conditioned discrete diffusion recommender supervised by counterfactual catalog-partition utility. Given a fixed tokenizer and a partially masked SID state, CONCORD-Rec evaluates out-of-fold teacher coalitions over the exact feasible catalog support and aggregates item posteriors across the target code partition at each unresolved position. Rather than distilling raw token probabilities directly, the resulting counterfactual loss differences supervise an availability-masked tokenwise gate that allocates bounded modality residual
papers.score_note: CONCORD-Rec：多模态 SID 离散扩散推荐，用反事实目录划分效用监督模态门控，处理缺失/冲突模态。核心生成式推荐。

papers.title: Improving LLM-Based Recommenders with Conservative Generative Flow Networks
papers.authors: Xuan Yu, Feng Niu, Rui Zhu, Yudong Zhang, Xu Wang, Yang Wang
papers.summary: 生成流网络近来被用来提高大模型推荐的多样性、减轻流行度偏差，但多数目标仍是按在线式假设来写的。离线推荐只能在一份固定日志里学习，token 转移只覆盖这份数据所能支持的前缀，若把子轨迹平衡目标原样搬过来，问题会变得不可辨识，还可能把概率质量分到数据并不支持的区域。文章把这种失效形式化，并指出三类会让学到的策略偏离数据隐含策略的来源：流被高估、前向质量泄漏，以及后向补偿。对应的保守目标会显式惩罚不被支持的前向流，并在数据集约束下做策略学习。==离线推荐不能把为在线设定写的流网络目标原样搬过来。==
papers.abstract: Generative Flow Networks (GFlowNets) have recently been used to improve diversity and mitigate popularity bias in LLM-based recommender systems, yet most objectives are developed under online-style assumptions. In offline LLM-based recommendation, learning is constrained to a fixed logged dataset, yielding partial support over token transitions on the dataset-induced token-prefix DAG. Naively applying Sub-Trajectory Balance (SubTB) becomes non-identifiable and can arbitrarily allocate probability mass to unsupported regions. We formalize this failure and identify three sources of non-identifiability that induce distributional shift between the dataset-implied policy and the learned policy: (i) flow overestimation, (ii) forward mass leakage, and (iii) backward compensation. To address it, we propose CFlower, which introduces a conservative SubTB objective that explicitly penalizes unsupported forward flow mass, and combines it with dataset-constrained policy learning with on-policy samp
papers.score_note: 用 Conservative GFlowNets 改进离线 LLM 推荐的多样性与流行度偏差，并形式化 SubTB 在离线设定下的不可辨识问题。

papers.title: Mitigating Reward Hacking in LLM-based Recommendation: A Preference Optimization Approach
papers.authors: Heyu Chen, Junkang Wu, Guoqing Hu, Kexin Huang, Xiang Wang, Jiancan Wu
papers.summary: 给大模型推荐做后期适配时，DPO 这类偏好优化能加强成对偏好的区分，却容易出现奖励被钻空子的情况：模型抓住奖励信号里的缺陷，训练指标看起来涨了，推荐效果却没有真正变好。从梯度角度看，成对更新对正样本和未采样负样本之间的排序几乎不起作用，会形成一块不敏感区域。在 Bradley-Terry 模型下，这类区域可以占掉偏好空间的相当一部分，不可避免地让排序走偏，因为模型没有真正学会把正样本从那些从未成对出现过的负样本里分开。方法为此引入伪负样本，用模拟出的偏好优化去压这类钻空子的行为，让更新也能触及原先几乎不受影响的排序。==只盯成对偏好，还不够约束对未采样物品的排序。==
papers.abstract:
Post-training adaptation has become the central paradigm for leveraging large language models (LLMs) in recommendation. 
While recent preference optimization methods, such as Direct Preference Optimization (DPO), enhance pairwise preference discrimination, they remain vulnerable to \emph{reward hacking}: models exploit imperfections in reward signals, leading to inflated training metrics without genuine recommendation gains.
We analyze this issue from a gradient perspective and formalize the concept of the 
\emph{$\varepsilon$-insensitive region}, where pairwise updates exert little influence on the ordering between positives and unsampled negatives.
Under the Bradley–Terry model, we further show that these regions can occupy a substantial fraction of the preference space, inevitably leading to misaligned rankings.
To address this issue, we propose Simulated Preference Optimization for Reward-hacking mitigation using Pseudo-negatives (SIRIUS). 
Our framework introduces pseudo-negative
papers.score_note: 缓解 LLM 推荐中的 reward hacking，偏好优化。

papers.title: Token-Efficient Long-Term Interest Sketching and Internalized Reasoning for LLM-based Recommendation
papers.authors: Zhihao Ding, Jinming Li, Shuai Mu, Jieming Shi
papers.summary: 用大模型给推荐做偏好推理时，会碰上两件很实际的事。用户历史往往又长又吵，动辄上百条，截断会丢掉刻画长期兴趣所需的信号；而在只解码的结构里，思维链还要逐步生成推理 token，推理延迟很难真正上线。一套框架同时处理这两头：先不把原始历史整段喂进去，而是把物品描述编码并聚类，做成长度受限的兴趣速写，用来保留稳定偏好、压掉噪声，让模型在有限的 token 预算里仍能看到长期兴趣；同时把推理内化进模型，而不必每次都把理由 token 逐个写出来。这样，推荐推理既不必吞下整段嘈杂历史，也不必为每一次打分付出逐步生成长篇理由的代价。==长期兴趣要先被压短，推理也不必每次都写在字面上。==
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can solve complex real-world tasks when prompted to generate chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning, motivating their use for preference reasoning in recommender systems. However, applying LLM reasoning on recommendation faces  two practical challenges. First, LLMs struggle to reason over long, noisy user histories that often span hundreds of items while truncation discards signals needed to capture long-term interests. Second, in decoder-only architectures, CoT requires generating rationale tokens autoregressively, leading to prohibitive inference latency for real-world deployment. To address the challenges, we propose SIREN, a framework that enables effective LLM-based rating prediction via long-term interest sketching and internalized reasoning. First, instead of prompting raw histories, we build a compact, token-bounded interest sketch that preserves persistent preferences and suppresses noise. Specifically, we encode and cluster item descriptions to discover
papers.score_note: Token-Efficient Long-Term Interest Sketching + 内化推理的 LLM 推荐。

papers.title: Self-EvolveRec: Self-Evolving Recommender Systems with LLM-based Directional Feedback
papers.authors: Sein Kim, Sangwu Park, HongSeok Kang, Wonjoong Kim, Jimin Seo, Yeonjun In, Kanghoon Yoon, Hyunsik Jeon, Chanyoung Park
papers.summary: 想自动设计推荐模型时，神经网络结构搜索往往被人手划定的算子空间框住，创新只能发生在预先定义好的算子里。近年用大模型在开放代码空间里演化，又主要盯着 NDCG 或命中率这类标量，模型错在哪里、下一步该往哪改，反馈是没有方向的。一套框架补上方向性反馈：用用户模拟器给出定性批评，再用诊断工具做定量的内部检查，并让诊断标准随着推荐结构一起演化，避免评估尺子本身停在旧结构上。在 CDs 数据集上从 SASRec 出发，NDCG@5 从 0.3559 提高到 0.3865，也高于同一起点上的 DeepEvolve（0.3610）。==自动改推荐模型，需要能指出问题在哪、该往哪改的反馈，而不只是一个分数。==
papers.abstract: Traditional methods for automating recommender system design, such as Neural Architecture Search (NAS), are often constrained by a fixed search space defined by human priors, limiting innovation to pre-defined operators. While recent LLM-driven code evolution frameworks shift fixed search space target to open-ended program spaces, they primarily rely on scalar metrics (e.g., NDCG, Hit Ratio) that fail to provide qualitative insights into model failures or directional guidance for improvement. To address this, we propose Self-EvolveRec, a novel framework that establishes a directional feedback loop by integrating a User Simulator for qualitative critiques and a Model Diagnosis Tool for quantitative internal verification. Furthermore, we introduce a Diagnosis Tool - Model Co-Evolution strategy to ensure that evaluation criteria dynamically adapt as the recommendation architecture evolves. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Self-EvolveRec significantly outperforms state-of-the-art NAS
papers.score_note: Self-EvolveRec：用 LLM 方向性反馈做自进化推荐。

papers.title: Steering Diffusion Models Towards Credible Content Recommendation
papers.authors: Zhuo Cai, Shoujin Wang, Jin Li, Peilin Zhou, Victor W. Chu, Fang Chen, Tianqing Zhu, Charu C. Aggarwal
papers.summary: 扩散模型因为善于刻画物品内容和用户行为的复杂分布，已经被用进推荐系统，推荐效果往往也不错。可现有方法常常只追推荐准不准，并不去管推荐内容是否可信，于是可能生成假新闻、不实信息这类不可信内容，对社会带来的伤害并不小。一套方法想把扩散模型推向更可信的内容推荐：它把扩散目标改写成，鼓励按与偏好相关的信号来生成，同时抑制按不可信内容作为条件的生成，并设计解耦的扩散过程，以减轻不可信内容对生成过程的影响，同时尽量保住推荐准确性。==内容推荐不能只看准不准，还要看生成出来的东西是否可信。==
papers.abstract: In recent years, diffusion models (DMs) have achieved remarkable success in recommender systems (RSs), owing to their strong capacity to model the complex distributions of item content and user behaviors. Despite their effectiveness, existing methods pose the danger of generating uncredible content recommendations (e.g., fake news, misinformation) that may significantly harm social well-being, as they primarily emphasize recommendation accuracy while neglecting the credibility of the recommended content. To address this issue, in this paper, we propose Disco, a novel method to steer diffusion models towards credible content recommendation. Specifically, we design a novel disentangled diffusion model to mitigate the harmful influence of uncredible content on the generation process while preserving high recommendation accuracy. papers.score_note: 引导扩散模型做可信内容推荐，偏内容生成，记 adjacent。

papers.title: RxDiff: Discrete Diffusion for Medication Recommendation with Inference-Time Safety Control
papers.authors: Jinke Feng, Wenjie Du, Xuchang Zhong, Yang Wang
papers.summary: 用药推荐要给出疗效好、药物相互作用又少的组合，难处正在于处方是组合出来的：药与药之间会互相影响，不能当成互不相关的标签来逐个打。判别方法常常把每种药单独预测，忽略这些依赖；自回归方法虽然引入了顺序依赖，却强加了任意的生成次序，还会把错误累积下去。两类做法都主要在训练时用惩罚来压相互作用，对单张处方在推理时的调控能力有限。文章把用药推荐写成离散扩散：迭代去噪可以双向修改已有选择，并在每一步加入推理时对相互作用的感知调节，让安全约束不必只留在训练损失里。==药物组合的安全约束，应该能在推理过程里被实时管住。==
papers.abstract:
Medication recommendation requires generating drug combinations that are therapeutically effective while minimizing harmful drug-drug interactions (DDIs). Both objectives are rooted in the combinatorial nature of prescriptions. Existing discriminative methods predict drugs independently, neglecting inter-drug dependencies; autoregressive methods introduce sequential dependencies but impose arbitrary generation orders and accumulate errors. Both paradigms confine DDI mitigation to training-time penalties, offering limited capacity to regulate interactions during inference for individual prescriptions. We reformulate medication recommendation as a discrete diffusion process and propose RxDiff, which leverages iterative denoising for bidirectional and revisable generation and provides a natural interface for dynamic DDI regulation at each step. A clinically grounded dual-guided forward process and an inference-time 
interaction-aware modulation mechanism are designed to jointly enable RxD
papers.score_note: RxDiff：用药组合的离散扩散推荐，领域特殊。

papers.title: SMI: Ontology-Grounded Semantic IDs for Hierarchy-Aware Medical Concept Representation
papers.authors: Ziyang Song, Lia Shen, YIXUAN LI, Qincheng Lu, Weihao Li, Haoran Xu, He Zhu, Xinyu Wang, Yue Li
papers.summary: 生物医学语言模型在临床任务上表征很强，却常常抓不住医疗概念之间的层级，越稀有、越细的临床编码就越难用，因为忽略层级的向量会随着概念变少而越来越不说明问题。一套无需再训练的方法，把每个诊断、操作或药物概念的 Semantic ID 定义成专家本体里从粗到细的路径，再把冻结的生物医学模型向量按这些层级聚合，让粗粒度语义能够托住细粒度编码。基础做法对各个层级均匀聚合，也可按验证集为不同层级选择权重。在 MIMIC-IV 的药物推荐上，按验证集选择层级权重的变体，AUPRC、F 分数和 Jaccard 分别为 77.6%、65.3% 和 50.5%，显著优于最强基线。==把层级写进标识本身，罕见概念才能借到上层的语义。==
papers.abstract: Biomedical language models (LMs) provide strong representations for clinical tasks, but they often fail to capture the hierarchical structure among medical concepts. This limitation is especially pronounced for rare and fine-grained clinical codes in long-tailed vocabularies, where hierarchy-agnostic LM representations become less informative as concept frequency decreases. We introduce Semantic Medical Identifier (SMI), a training-free framework for constructing ontology-grounded Semantic IDs and hierarchy-aware medical concept representations. For each diagnosis, procedure, or medication concept, SMI defines its Semantic ID as the coarse-to-fine path through an expert-defined medical ontology. SMI then aggregates frozen biomedical LM embeddings across the corresponding ontology levels to form hierarchy-aware medical concept representations that preserve coarse-to-fine clinical semantics. papers.score_note: SMI：医疗概念的 ontology-grounded semantic IDs，SID 技术但不是商品生成式推荐。
